fields.title: Milestone 3 triage (mock data)
fields.goal: Agree what ships in Milestone 3 and who owns the open risks
fields.decisions:
Code freeze moves to Friday 18:00
No new features after the freeze without producer sign-off
fields.parking:
Localisation vendor contract renewal
Build farm disk space

agenda.d: Fix before the milestone build; block the build until it is in
agenda.n:
Repro rate is about 1 in 20 loads on the devkit, none on PC
Crash dump points at the streaming system, not the new shaders
Seen since the asset bundle change last Tuesday
QA can give a repro save by tomorrow morning

agenda.d: Cut from Milestone 3, revisit for Milestone 4
agenda.n:
Backend is ready but the conflict UI is not designed yet
Cert risk is high if save conflicts are not handled
Marketing has not announced the feature, so cutting is cheap

Four of twelve testers could not find the remapping menu
Two testers asked for per-profile layouts
UX wants to move the menu under Settings > Controls
Accessibility review flagged missing one-handed presets
No agreement yet on whether presets are in scope

agenda.d: Hold a short audio sync on Wednesday
agenda.n:
Audio team needs final cinematics timing by Thursday
Build times went up about 10 percent this week
New QA contractor starts Monday

actions.a: Send repro save and devkit logs to engineering
Bisect the asset bundle change and post findings
Add a crash-free load check to the milestone build gate
Tell marketing and the backend team cloud saves move to M4
Draft two options for the remapping menu location
Ask accessibility consultant which presets are must-have
